command:
set +e
set -uo pipefail
# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; `set -uo pipefail` does not clear it (spawn#707).
export PATH=${CONDA_PREFIX:-/opt/conda}/bin:$PATH TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp LC_ALL=C
cd /tmp/inst || { echo "FAIL: nothing staged"; exit 1; }
# Pin the OpenAlex institutions parts as copied into the bucket: sha256 of every part, on AWS.
find . -name 'part_*.gz' | sed 's|^\./||' | sort > /tmp/parts.txt
echo "parts $(wc -l < /tmp/parts.txt)"
xargs sha256sum < /tmp/parts.txt > /tmp/institutions.sha256
# the source's own manifest: every part it lists is here, at its stated size
Rscript -e '
m <- jsonlite::fromJSON("/tmp/manifest.json")
f <- m$files; rel <- sub("^s3://openalex/data/jsonl/institutions/", "", f$url)
got <- readLines("/tmp/parts.txt")
stopifnot(setequal(rel, got), length(rel) == 83, m$record_count == 143455)
sz <- file.size(file.path("/tmp/inst", rel))
stopifnot(all(sz == f$meta$content_length), sum(sz) == m$content_length)
cat("manifest: 83 parts, sizes match, record_count", m$record_count, "\n")
' || { echo "FAIL: the staged parts are not the manifest's"; exit 1; }
cat /tmp/institutions.sha256
echo DONE
